args.goal: Find the banking account with the maximum spending and then identify the top spending category (counter account) within that account.

steps.title: Find all banking accounts
steps.description: Retrieve a list of all accounts that are classified as banking accounts.

steps.title: Calculate total spending per banking account
steps.description: For each banking account, calculate the total amount spent (where the banking account is the credit account).

steps.title: Identify top spending category for max spending account
steps.description: For the banking account with the maximum spending, identify the counter account that represents the highest spending category.

steps.title: Report max spending account and category
steps.description: Summarize the banking account with the highest spending and its top spending category.

args.query: SELECT id, name FROM account WHERE org_id = 'org_indian_demo' AND type @> ARRAY['BANK']::text[]
args.description: Find all accounts classified as 'BANK' type.

args.query:
SELECT
  a.id AS account_id,
  a.name AS account_name,
  SUM(p.amount) AS total_spending
FROM posting p
JOIN account a ON p.credit_account_id = a.id
WHERE p.org_id = 'org_indian_demo'
  AND a.type @> ARRAY['BANK']::text[]
  AND (p.posting_type IS NULL OR p.posting_type <> 'DUPLICATE')
  AND (p.description IS NULL OR p.description NOT ILIKE '%Closing%')
GROUP BY a.id, a.name
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
args.description: Calculate the total spending for each banking account where the banking account is the credit account (money leaving the account).

args.result_summary: Calculated total spending for 5 banking accounts. The account with the maximum spending is 'Checking Account' (acco_org_bangalore_office_1102) with a total spending of 5603553.8.

args.query:
SELECT
  a_counter.name AS counter_account_name,
  SUM(p.amount) AS category_spending
FROM posting p
JOIN account a_counter ON p.account_id = a_counter.id
WHERE p.org_id = 'org_indian_demo'
  AND p.credit_account_id = 'acco_org_bangalore_office_1102'
  AND (p.posting_type IS NULL OR p.posting_type <> 'DUPLICATE')
  AND (p.description IS NULL OR p.description NOT ILIKE '%Closing%')
GROUP BY a_counter.name
ORDER BY category_spending DESC
LIMIT 1
args.description: For the banking account with the maximum spending, identify the counter account that represents the highest spending category.

args.result_summary: The top spending category for the banking account 'Checking Account' (acco_org_bangalore_office_1102) is 'Salaries & Wages' with a total spending of 1993920.
